e.title: Open-Insurance-LLM (Llama3-8B)
e.summary: 保险领域 LLM（Raj-Maharajwala，Llama3-ChatQA-1.5-8B 微调）：保险查询/对话微调模型（InsuranceQA 数据集）
e.summary_en: Insurance domain LLM (Raj-Maharajwala, fine-tuned from Llama3-ChatQA-1.5-8B): fine-tuned for insurance queries/conversations (InsuranceQA dataset)
e.summary_hk: 保險領域 LLM（Raj-Maharajwala，Llama3-ChatQA-1.5-8B 微調）：保險查詢/對話微調模型（InsuranceQA 數據集）
e.body: Open-Insurance-LLM（Raj-Maharajwala，Llama3 8B，246+ 下载/4+ likes，llama3 license）是基于 Nvidia Llama3-ChatQA-1.5-8B 微调的保险领域语言模型：用 InsuranceQA 数据集微调——处理保险查询与对话（含 GGUF 量化版）。对 RIAA：保险领域微调 LLM——[[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]]（保险专家 LoRA）的 8B 版本；InsuranceQA 数据集微调（[[insurance-qa-en]] 同类）；保险客服/咨询对话（[[insurance-support-agent]] 模型层）；量化版（GGUF）本地部署；与 [[qwen-dianjin]]（中文金融 LLM）配套；适合保险 LLM 微调与部署。
e.body_en: Open-Insurance-LLM (Raj-Maharajwala, Llama3 8B, 246+ downloads/4+ likes, llama3 license) is an insurance-domain language model fine-tuned from Nvidia Llama3-ChatQA-1.5-8B: fine-tuned on the InsuranceQA dataset — handling insurance queries and conversations (with GGUF quantised versions). For RIAA: an insurance-domain fine-tuned LLM — the 8B version of [[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]] (insurance expert LoRA); fine-tuned on InsuranceQA data (similar to [[insurance-qa-en]]); insurance customer-service/consultation dialogue (the model layer of [[insurance-support-agent]]); quantised (GGUF) for local deployment; pairs with [[qwen-dianjin]] (Chinese financial LLMs); suits insurance LLM fine-tuning and deployment.
e.body_hk: Open-Insurance-LLM（Raj-Maharajwala，Llama3 8B，246+ 下載/4+ likes，llama3 license）是基於 Nvidia Llama3-ChatQA-1.5-8B 微調的保險領域語言模型：用 InsuranceQA 數據集微調——處理保險查詢與對話（含 GGUF 量化版）。對 RIAA：保險領域微調 LLM——[[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]]（保險專家 LoRA）的 8B 版本；InsuranceQA 數據集微調（[[insurance-qa-en]] 同類）；保險客服/諮詢對話（[[insurance-support-agent]] 模型層）；量化版（GGUF）本地部署；與 [[qwen-dianjin]]（中文金融 LLM）配套；適合保險 LLM 微調與部署。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：HF 模型（246 dl），未实测
